**Question:** A charge of $3\text{ C}$ is experiencing a force of $10\text{ N}$. What is the electric field?\
**Answer:** We know $F = qE$

So, 
$$E = \frac{F}{q}$$

Here, 
$$F = 10\text{ N}$$
$$q = 3\text{ C}$$

Therefore,
$$E = \frac{F}{q} = \frac{10\text{ N}}{3\text{ C}} = 3.33\text{ N/C}$$
